rows.note: Use 好 as the all-purpose choice for something generally pleasant, nice, or desirable.

example.english: This café has a lovely atmosphere.
example.traditional: 呢間咖啡店環境好舒服。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 waan4 ging2 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use 靚 when lovely mainly means beautiful or visually attractive.

example.english: Those flowers you bought are really lovely.
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 go2 cuk1 faa1 zan1 hai6 leng3

rows.note: Use 可愛 when lovely describes someone or something charming, cute, or endearing rather than simply beautiful.

example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 maau1 zai2 zan1 hai6 ho2 oi3

rows.note: Use 正 for an enthusiastic, colloquial sense of nice or wonderful.

example.english: The pineapple bun at this cha chaan teng is really lovely.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記嘅菠蘿包真係正。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1 zan1 hai6 zing3
